# Vendored SARIF schema

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the **unmodified OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 errata01 JSON
Schema**, retrieved on 2026-11-12 from the
[OASIS source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oasis-tcs/sarif-spec/main/sarif-2.1/schema/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json).
Its own `id` identifies the
[published schema](https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json).

SHA-256: `c3b4bb2d6093897483348925aaa73af03b3e3f4bd4ca38cef26dcb4212a2682e`.
The adapter checks this digest before using the schema. Validation uses local
internal references only; the report's `$schema` is never downloaded.

Attribution and terms: OASIS Open, SARIF Technical Committee;
[repository license terms](https://github.com/oasis-tcs/sarif-spec/blob/main/LICENSE.md)
and [OASIS IPR policy](https://www.oasis-open.org/policies-guidelines/ipr/).
This file is not maintained by TBO-STUDIO. Do not silently substitute a modified
schema: review any update and update the digest explicitly.
